recognize_zh: 移植後復發 AML 接受供者淋巴球輸注（DLI）後的骨髓切片，A 圖可見成片小至中型淋巴樣單核細胞浸潤取代造血組織，C、D 圖免疫染色顯示大量陽性的淋巴球（膜性/細胞質強染），代表密集的 T 淋巴球浸潤，符合移植物抗白血病（GVL）反應的影像。
features: Hypercellular marrow largely replaced by a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small to medium mononuclear lymphoid cells
Lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; no obvious blast sheets
Scattered larger histiocytoid cells within the infiltrate
IHC panel B: membranous positivity in a subset of cells and vessels
IHC panels C and D: strong positivity in the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes, supporting a T-cell-rich infiltrate
Antibody identities are not labeled in the figure
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy after donor lymphocyte infusion shows a hypercellular marrow with a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, replacing normal hematopoiesis. Discrete sheets of myeloblasts are not evident on the morphologic panel. Immunohistochemical stains (antibodies not labeled in the figure) show strong staining of the majority of infiltrating lymphocytes, with a subset of cells showing membranous staining in a separate stain. In the clinical context of remission after DLI, findings are consistent with a donor T-cell-mediated graft-versus-leukemia infiltrate in the marrow; correlation with chimerism studies and exclusion of residual leukemia are required.

ddx.vs: Relapse shows sheets of blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli that are CD34/CD117/MPO positive, whereas this infiltrate is composed of mature-appearing lymphocytes staining with lymphoid markers.
PTLD is usually a B-cell (often EBV-positive, EBER+) proliferation with atypical large cells, while a GVL infiltrate is polyclonal T-cell-rich.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows cytologic atypia, aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which are not expected in a reactive donor T-cell infiltrate.
